as_told.title: Kirkpatrick attended Fugal's confidential Skinwalker Ranch briefing in April 2018

plain: A podcast host, Jesse Michels, discussing the Pentagon's work on UFOs, says there are pictures of a man named Sean Kirkpatrick in a meeting with another man, Brandon Fugal. Michels does not say exactly when or where the meeting took place, only that it was in the 2020s in the United States. He raises the photos as a sign of contacts he thinks are worth noticing.
